Name: AvatarBall Hajiki
Overview:
AvatarBall is a multiplayer ball-playing action game. Control the AvatarBall and aim to hit your rivals and get over 100,000 points! Hit them with a smash after hitting them to earn a massive score.

Your score is calculated as ball-play points * survival points, so it's best to survive, but running away won't increase your score! Hitting them with a ball gives you an advantage, so corner them against the wall and trap them!
